bin2_caveats.stays_in_weekend_nights / stays_in_week_: Final length of stay; can be amended before arrival.
bin2_caveats.adults / children / babies: Final party size; can change before arrival.
bin2_caveats.meal: Final board basis; can be amended.
bin2_caveats.days_in_waiting_list: Final once the booking is confirmed; 97% are zero.
bin2_caveats.adr: Final average rate; amendments change it. A derived value (revenue / nights).
bin2_caveats.booking_changes (NOT ADOPTED): Counted until check-in or cancellation, so a cancelled booking has less time to accumulate changes: partly an outcome proxy.
bin2_caveats.total_of_special_requests (NOT ADOPTED): Accumulates until arrival or cancellation: same truncation by the outcome.
